correctness.rationale: Cell Bloch H(k) has bands ±sqrt(a²+b²+2ab cos k), physical velocity v=-2ab sin k/E; projection weight s_even(k)-(w/a)v(k). Parity cancels s_even, and the phase angular pushforward gives arcsine with factor 1-(w/a)y. The a=b gap closing is correctly handled by ordinary one-site Fourier. Independent 65536-point half-grid Bloch moment calculations for a<b, a>b, a=b and four phases agree through moment order 8; weak limit proof requires band differentiation and moment tightness, not finite grids.
residual_risks: Finite numerical tests do not substitute for infinite analytic proof; source proof independently examined.
